'''Kado Oquoné'''<ref name="Novel" /> was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as a [[captain]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. During the [[Battle of Scarif]],<ref name="Rogue One" /> Oquoné was in command of the [[Sphyrna-class Hammerhead corvette|''Sphyrna''-class Hammerhead corvette]] ''[[Lightmaker]]''.<ref name="Novel" />

After his ship was damaged he took it away from the line of fire to guard the line of retreat. Late in the battle, [[Admiral]] [[Raddus]] ordered Oquoné to ram his corvette into the side of a disabled Star Destroyer, ''[[Persecutor]]'', forcing it into a second Star Destroyer, ''[[Intimidator]]'', sending it into the [[Shield Gate]] protecting Scarif. The action disabled the Shield Gate and allowed the [[Rogue One|Rebels]] on [[Scarif]] to transmit the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[Death Star plans|plans]] to Raddus. The ''Lightmaker'', along with its skeleton crew, was destroyed in the crash. Oquoné's actions resulted in the capture of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[Death Star plans|plans]] by the Rebels, which were later used to exploit a weakness in the [[battle station]] and destroy it during the [[Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="Novel" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kado Oquoné was portrayed by British actor [[Angus Wright]] in ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Rogue One" /> ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' mistakenly states that Oquoné served in the [[Alliance Army]],<ref name="UVG">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref> when the film depicts him in a naval capacity.<ref name="Rogue One" />
